caveat: n=5, directional only. A bimodal shape is a different problem from a low score: the nav works for one usage mode and breaks another. Detractors named Promo Codes, Ad Tools, Deals, Surveys and Dashboard.
posthog_label: Partner dashboard: navigation and exit paths
scope: Partners who answered the in-product poll
statement: Reaction to the new navigation is bimodal, not simply negative: 60% rated it 1, 40% rated 4-5, nothing in between.
